bullets.title: The Innovative Heated Wearable Breast Pump
bullets.text: Groundbreaking HeatFlow technology prevents clogs and boosts your output by 30%¹. Enjoy high-efficiency pumping with spa-like warmth. Note: 1. Based on actual usage feedback from over 300 eufy pump users.

bullets.title: Industry-Leading Wireless Charging Case for Pumping Anywhere
bullets.text: This charging case keeps your pump ready even on the go. With up to five days of power, it ensures hassle-free pumping sessions during business days or weekend getaways.

bullets.title: Smart Pumping, Tailored for You
bullets.text: With cutting-edge OptiRhythm in the eufy Baby app, customize pumping rhythm, suction, and speed for a truly hands-free experience.

bullets.title: 30% More Output with Hospital-Grade Suction
bullets.text: Up to 300 mmHg of hospital-grade suction with adjustable intensity and cycle speeds helps maximize your milk flow. Note: All skin-contact parts are made from BPA-free, food-grade materials. For optimal suction, purify all washable parts by boiling or steaming for 5 minutes before first use. Make sure the duckbill valve, flange tunnel, diaphragm, and pump hub are securely sealed.

bullets.title: Ultra-Quiet and Slim for Privacy
bullets.text: Compact, lightweight, and whisper-quiet at 46 dB, this pump is perfect for in-bra use. It's also leakproof with a secure double seal and a reinforced lower half. Note: For suction or heating issues, check the Q&A for quick solutions.

bullets.title: HydroJet System
bullets.text: Equipped with a Dual Water Reservoir and a dual-scraper structure, E28 cleans the mop in real-time, ensuring it stays fresh throughout the cleaning session.

bullets.title: FlexiOne Portable Deep Cleaner
bullets.text: Industry's First Detachable Portable Deep Cleaner — Integrated into the Omni Station to tackle every mess, from carpets to stairs and other fabric surfaces.

bullets.title: 20,000 Pa Turbo Suction
bullets.text: E28 delivers professional-grade deep cleaning on both carpets and floors. It effectively removes even the deepest dust and hair, leaving your home spotless.

bullets.title: DuoSpiral Detangle Brushes
bullets.text: DuoSpiral Brushes prevent hair entanglement and reduce maintenance frequency, providing a hassle-free cleaning experience.

bullets.title: CornerRover Arm
bullets.text: ensures 100% edge coverage for seamless cleaning.

bullets.title: All-in-One Station
bullets.text: With self-emptying, self-washing, hot air drying, automatic detergent dispensing, wastewater collection, and self-refilling, you can enjoy a hands-free experience.

bullets.title: To ensure optimal cleaning performance, we recommend
bullets.text: Updating to the latest firmware through the app for enhanced functionality.

bullets.title: Stability in Every Mode
bullets.text: Sturdy zinc alloy stand with a double-ring design provides strong support, keeping your phone stable in both landscape and portrait modes and freeing your hands.

bullets.title: Easy Grip by One Hand
bullets.text: The dual-ring magnetic design helps you use your phone more easily.
It provides stable support whether you're holding, taking photos, or controlling the Capture Button with one hand, user-friendly even for small hands.

bullets.title: Strong Magnetic Force
bullets.text: The MagSafe grip features powerful magnets that snap into place effortlessly. With a magnetic strength of up to 1.2kg, it allows you to carry your device with just a finger, giving you peace of mind that your phone won't slip or drop.

bullets.title: Sleek and Secure
bullets.text: At a mere 5.9mm thick, the grip easily slips into your pocket without adding bulk. Placed on the desk, it elevates your phone to keep the lenses scratch-free.

bullets.text: Aramid fiber repurposed from camera ring leftovers reduces resources.

bullets.title: Tap-and-Go
bullets.text: Still fumbling for your card? Our all-new wallet features built-in NFC support, whether you're commuting or traveling, just tap and go. One-hand operation lets you skip the card-pulling step entirely, saving you time and supercharging your efficiency.

bullets.title: Powerful Magnetic
bullets.text: Featuring built-in N52-grade magnets, our wallet locks onto any MagSafe-compatible device with unshakeable force — whether it's tucked into your pocket or bag, it won't slip or fall. Neatly holds 1 — 2 cards in place for instant, worry-free access every time.

bullets.title: Demagnetization Proof
bullets.text: A precision-engineered metal layer is nestled between the card compartment and the magnets, effectively blocking any magnetic interference. Your cards stay fully protected and fully functional — no demagnetization, no worries, just seamless everyday use.

bullets.title: Ultra-Light 38g Profile
bullets.text: Weighing in at just 38 grams, this slim wallet feels virtually weightless. Its ergonomic form ensures a fatigue-free grip, so you can hold it comfortably — anytime, anywhere.
